source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 8 exercise solved (PDF 203-204), MCQ keys worked out from the chapter, model answers for every question.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Plant Physiology) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Process by which water evaporates from surface of leaf primarily through stomata:
(Woh amal jis mein pani zyada tar stomata ke zariye patte ki surface se bhaap ban kar urta hai:)
blocks.explanation: Transpiration woh amal hai jis mein pani patton ki surface se, khaas tor par stomata ke raste, bhaap (vapour) ban kar nikalta hai (8.5).

blocks.prompt:
2. Through which structure does most of transpiration occurs?
(Zyada tar transpiration kis structure ke zariye hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pani ki bhaap stomata se bahar nikalti hai; stomata ka khulna aur band hona transpiration ki raftar control karta hai (8.2).

blocks.prompt:
3. The TACT theory primarily explains
(TACT theory bunyadi tor par kya samjhati hai?)
blocks.explanation: TACT (Transpiration, Adhesion, Cohesion, Tension) batata hai ke pani gravity ke khilaf xylem mein jaron se patton tak kaise charhta hai (8.5).

blocks.prompt:
4. Which of the following is not a function of xylem?
(In mein se kaun sa xylem ka kaam nahi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Xylem pani aur ghule hue minerals le jata hai aur sahara deta hai; khurak (sugars) phloem le jata hai (8.5, 8.6).

blocks.prompt:
5. Which of the following has a perforated cell wall?
(In mein se kis ki cell wall mein surakh (perforations) hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Vessels ke siron par perforation plates (surakh wali deewarein) hoti hain jin se pani aasani se guzarta hai; tracheids bordered pits se jurte hain, perforations se nahi (8.5).

blocks.prompt:
6. Exposure to low temperature stimulates the process of flowering in biennial or perennial plants:
(Biennial ya perennial plants mein kam temperature se phool aane ka amal tez hona:)
blocks.explanation: Biennial aur perennial plants kam temperature (thand) milne se phool dete hain; isay vernalisation kehte hain (taqreeban 4°C behtareen) (printed 7.12).

blocks.prompt:
7. Plants that are adapted to survive in dry conditions:
(Woh plants jo khushk halaat mein zinda rehne ke qabil hain:)
blocks.explanation: Xerophytes khushk halaat ke plants hain; yeh pani ka nuqsan kam karte aur pani zakheera karte hain (maslan succulents, blue agave) (8.8).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (a) kitab mein "Xerophhytes" chhapa hai (spelling ki ghalti); sahi lafz "Xerophytes" hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. When sugar content in a cell increases the concentration of solute increases, what happens to the water potential?
(Jab cell mein sugar barhti hai to solute ki concentration barh jati hai; water potential ka kya hota hai?)

options.text: Gir jata hai (kam ho jata hai)

blocks.explanation: Zyada solute se solute potential (Ψs) zyada manfi (negative) hota hai, is liye water potential gir jata hai; guard cells mein sugar barhne se water potential girta hai aur pani andar aata hai (8.2, 8.4).

blocks.prompt:
9. In higher plant, transport of food materials occurs through;
(Aala (higher) plants mein khurak ki transport kis ke zariye hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sieve tube elements sire se sira jur kar sieve tubes banate hain jo sugars aur organic cheezein le jati hain; companion cells sirf un ko ATP aur proteins dete hain (8.6).

blocks.prompt:
10. The plant hormone which inhibits the stem and root growth is
(Kaun sa plant hormone tane (stem) aur jar (root) ki growth rokta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethylene stem ki growth (khaas kar stress mein) aur root ki growth dono rokta hai. Auxin, cytokinin aur gibberellin stem ki growth barhate hain (abscisic acid bhi dono rokta hai magar woh option mein nahi) (8.7).

blocks.prompt:
11. The leaves of some hydrophyte float on the surface of water. In such a leaf, stomata are found in;
(Kuch hydrophytes ke patte pani ki surface par tairte hain. Aise patte mein stomata kahan hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tairte patte (maslan water lily) ki neeche wali surface pani mein hoti hai, is liye hawa se gas exchange sirf upar se ho sakta hai; stomata upper epidermis mein hote hain (beyond the chapter: chapter yeh baat nahi batata).

blocks.prompt:
12. Mesophytes are adapted to survive in:
(Mesophytes kahan zinda rehne ke qabil hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mesophytes mo'tadil mahaul mein rehte hain jo na zyada khushk ho na zyada geela, maslan rose, tomato, daisy (8.8).

blocks.prompt:
1. Differentiate between macronutrients and micronutrients?
Macronutrients aur micronutrients mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono plants ke nutrients hain; farq zaroorat ki miqdar ka hai.

rows: Nisbatan zyada miqdar mein chahiye
Bohat thori miqdar mein chahiye
Nau (9): C, H, O, N, K, Ca, P, Mg, S
Saat (7): Fe, Mn, Zn, Mo, Cu, Cl, B
Misal: magnesium chlorophyll ka markaz (core) hai
Misal: iron chlorophyll banane ke liye zaroori hai

blocks.prompt:
2. What is water potential?
Water potential kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Water potential (Ψw) pani ke molecules ki harkat ki salahiyat (kinetic energy) ka naap hai. Khalis pani ka Ψw sab se zyada, yaani zero hota hai; solutions ka manfi (negative). Pani zyada Ψw se kam Ψw ki taraf jata hai. Ψw = Ψs + Ψp.

blocks.prompt:
3. What are the main three pathways for the movement of water between plant cells?
Plant cells ke darmiyan pani ki harkat ke teen bare raste kaun se hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Apoplast pathway: saath wali cell walls ke raste (endodermis par Casparian strip rok deti hai).
2. Symplast pathway: plasmodesmata se jure protoplasts ke raste.
3. Vacuolar pathway: vacuole se vacuole, membranes, cytoplasm aur tonoplast ke raste (bohat kam).

blocks.prompt:
4. Differentiate between hypertonic and hypotonic solution?
Hypertonic aur hypotonic solution mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Farq yeh hai ke solution mein solute cell ke andar ke muqable mein zyada hai ya kam.

rows: Cell ke andar se zyada solute
Cell ke andar se kam solute
Pani cell se bahar nikalta hai
Pani osmosis se cell mein dakhil hota hai
Cell sikurta hai: plasmolysis
Cell phoolta hai aur turgid ho jata hai

blocks.prompt:
5. What are halophytes?
Halophytes kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Halophytes woh plants hain jo namkeen (saline) zameen ya pani mein ugte hain jahan NaCl, MgCl₂, MgSO₄ zyada hon. In ke patte (kabhi tana bhi) gooddar (succulent) hote hain, kuch ke patte kanton (spines) mein badal jate hain. Misal: sea arrowgrass, sea lavender, mangroves.

blocks.prompt:
6. Differentiate between long day plants and short day plants?
Long day plants aur short day plants mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono photoperiodism ki bunyad par hain; asal ahem cheez raat (andhere) ki lambai hai.

rows: Raat critical length se chhoti ho to phool
Raat critical length se lambi ho to phool (long-night plants)
Red light / P730 phool aane mein madad deta hai
Red light / P730 phool aane ko rokta hai
Lambi raat mein roshni dal di jaye to chhote dinon mein bhi phool
Lambi raat mein roshni dal di jaye to phool nahi aate
Misal: henbane (13 h), snapdragon, cabbage, spring wheat
Misal: cocklebur (8.5 h), tobacco, chrysanthemum, soybean

blocks.prompt:
7. Write down the phases of plant growth?
Plant growth ke marahil (phases) likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Primary growth teen marahil mein hoti hai:
1. Cell division: apical meristem ke cells taqseem hote hain (chhote, bina vacuole).
2. Cell elongation: naye cells pani le kar lambe aur bare hote hain (vacuole wale).
3. Cell differentiation: cells mukammal ho kar khaas kaam ke liye makhsoos (specialize) ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
8. Differentiate between Vernalin and Florigen.
Vernalin aur Florigen mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono phool laane wale hormones hain, magar mukhtalif asar (stimulus) se bante hain.

rows: Kam temperature (vernalisation) se banta hai
Din/raat ki lambai (photoperiod, biological clock) se banta hai
Stimulus shoot apex ya beej ka embryo leta hai
Stimulus patte lete hain
Thand (taqreeban 4°C) ke baad biennials/perennials mein phool lata hai
Patton mein ban kar phloem ke raste phool ki kaliyon tak jata hai

blocks.prompt:
9. Differentiate between Thigmotropism and Geotropism.
Thigmotropism aur Geotropism mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono tropic (growth wali) harkatein hain; farq stimulus ka hai.

rows: Chhoone (touch) ke jawab mein harkat
Gravity (kashish-e-saql) ke jawab mein harkat
Chhoone wali jagah ke mukhalif taraf growth barhti hai, tendril lipat jata hai
Jarein gravity ki taraf, tana us ke mukhalif barhta hai
Misal: bel (climbing vines) ke tendrils sahare ke gird lipatte hain
Misal: jarein positive, tana negative geotropic

blocks.prompt:
10. How intercalary meristem is different from apical meristem?
Intercalary meristem apical meristem se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono meristems (taqseem hone wale tissues) hain magar jagah, umar aur kaam mein farq hai.

rows: Internodes ki bunyad (base) par, apex se permanent tissue ke zariye alag
Jaron aur shoots ki nok (tips) par
Aarzi (temporary)
Hamesha rehne wale growth zones
Patte aur phool banane mein madad (maslan ghaas)

blocks.prompt:
1. Describe osmoregulation in Hydrophytes and Halophytes?
Hydrophytes aur Halophytes mein osmoregulation bayan karein.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: namkeen pani mein pani BAHAR jata hai, is liye plant pani ROKTA hai (solutes, moti cuticle, namak nikalna). Meetha pani mein pani ANDAR aata hai, is liye plant pani NIKALTA hai (hydathodes) aur ions jama karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe the Physiological adaptation of plants to extreme conditions. How do plants adjust their cell membrane composition and protein structures to survive high and low temperatures?
Plants ki shadeed (extreme) halaat ke liye physiological adaptations bayan karein. Plants zyada aur kam temperature mein zinda rehne ke liye apni cell membrane aur proteins ko kaise badalte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Plants jagah nahi badal sakte, is liye shadeed halaat mein physiological tabdeeliyon (thermoregulation, osmoregulation) se zinda rehte hain.
A. Shadeed khushki aur namak (mukhtasar):
- Xerophytes gooddar tanon mein pani zakheera karte (succulents), patton par mom ki teh rakhte, khushk mausam mein patte gira ya mor lete hain.
- Halophytes ke gooddar patte/tane ya kante hote hain aur zyada namak bardasht karte hain.
- Pani ki kami (wilting) mein abscisic acid guard cells mein K⁺ ka pump rok deta hai, stomata band ho kar pani bachate hain.
B. Zyada temperature:
- Garmi enzymes ko denature (kharab) karti aur metabolism ko nuqsan deti hai.
- Plants transpiration se thanda hote hain (evaporative cooling); garm khushk mausam mein stomata band ho jate hain aur plant ko takleef hoti hai.
- Protein ki tabdeeli: 40°C ya zyada par cells heat-shock proteins bari miqdar mein banate hain jo enzymes aur doosre proteins ko lapet kar (embrace kar ke) un ki denaturation rokte hain.
C. Kam temperature:
- Thand se cell membrane ki rawani (fluidity) kam hoti hai: lipids crystal jaisi shakal mein jam jate hain, solutes ki transport mutasir hoti hai; membrane proteins ki structure bhi badalti hai.
- Membrane ki tabdeeli: plants membrane mein unsaturated fatty acids ka hissa barhate hain jo membrane ko rawan rakhte aur crystal banne se rokte hain. Is mein waqt lagta hai, is liye achanak thand ahista thand se zyada nuqsan deh hai.
- Barf: cell wall mein barf zyada nuqsan nahi karti, magar protoplasm ke andar barf ke crystals membranes aur organelles ko chhed kar cell maar dete hain. Thande ilaqon ke plants (oak, maple, rose) cells ke solutes badal kar cytosol ko bina barf bane supercool kar lete hain; barf sirf cell walls mein banti hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. What is the role of meristem in the growth of plants?
Plants ki growth mein meristem ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation:
Growth size mein mustaqil izafa hai. Aala plants mein growth sirf growing points par hoti hai jo meristems se bane hain: aise cells ke group jo musalsal taqseem (division) hote rehte hain. Plant ke tamam naye cells meristems banate hain.
Iqsam aur kaam:
1. Apical meristems: jaron aur shoots ki nok par; hamesha rehne wale growth zones jo cells ki tadaad barha kar plant ko lamba karte hain: primary growth (lambai).
2. Intercalary meristems: internodes ki bunyad par (maslan ghaas), apex se permanent tissue ke zariye alag; aarzi; patte aur phool banane mein madad.
3. Lateral meristems: woody plants ke tane aur jaron ke kinaron par taqseem hone wale cells ke silinder; secondary growth (motai) karte hain:
- Vascular cambium (xylem aur phloem ke darmiyan) andar secondary xylem aur bahar secondary phloem banata hai.
- Cork cambium (bahar ki teh) cork cells banata hai jo epidermis ki jagah le kar hifazati bark banate hain.
Apical meristem ki primary growth teen marahil mein: cell division, cell elongation aur cell differentiation (teen zones).
Lateral meristems ki secondary growth tana mota karti hai; vascular cambium ki mausami sargarmi annual rings (spring wood aur autumn wood) banati hai.
Yun meristems saari zindagi plant ki lambai, motai, shakhon, patton aur phoolon ko control karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe the mechanism of opening and closing of stomata?
Stomata ke khulne aur band hone ka tareeqa (mechanism) bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Stomata patton mein nanhe surakh hain; har stoma ko do loobiya (bean) shakal ke guard cells gherte hain jin mein chloroplasts hote hain. Guard cells hydraulic valve ki tarah kaam karte hain: turgid (phoole) hon to stoma khulta, flaccid (dheele) hon to band hota hai. Din mein CO₂ ke liye khulte, raat ko pani bachane ke liye band hote hain. Do hypotheses:
1. Starch-sugar hypothesis (H. Von Mohl, 1856):
- Din: guard cells photosynthesis se sugar banate hain; sugar barhne se water potential girta hai, pani osmosis se andar aata hai, cells turgid aur stoma khul jata hai.
- Raat: photosynthesis band; sugar insoluble starch mein badalti ya respiration mein lagti hai; pani bahar, cells flaccid, stoma band.
- Kami: stomata ki tez harkat ki wazahat nahi karti.
2. K⁺ ions ka dakhla (influx):
- Khulna: K⁺ active transport se guard cells mein jate hain, osmotic (solute) potential girta hai, pani andar, cells turgid, stoma khulta hai. Blue light mahaul ko tezabi (acidic) bana kar K⁺ ka dakhla barhati hai.
- Band hona: raat ko K⁺ khud ba khud (passively) bahar nikalte hain, pani bhi nikalta hai, cells flaccid, stoma band.
Hormone: garmi mein jab patte murjhane lagte hain to mesophyll cells abscisic acid (ABA) chhorte hain jo K⁺ ka pump rok deta hai; roshni aur CO₂ ke asar ke bawajood stomata band ho kar pani bachate hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Seedha usool: guard cell mein solute (sugar ya K⁺) barhe → water potential gire → pani andar → turgid → stoma KHULA. Solute kam ho → pani bahar → flaccid → stoma BAND.

blocks.prompt:
5. Explain the concept of photoperiodism and its influence on plant flowering. How do short-day, long-day and day-neutral plants differ in their flowering responses, and what role does phytochrome plays in this process?
Photoperiodism ka tasawwur aur phool aane par us ka asar samjhayein. Short-day, long-day aur day-neutral plants phool aane mein kaise mukhtalif hain, aur phytochrome is mein kya kirdar ada karta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Photoperiodism: din aur raat ki lambai par plant ka jawab, jis se woh mausami tabdeeliyon ke mutabiq dhalta hai. 1920 mein Garner aur Allard ne dekha ke tobacco sirf chhote dinon ke silsile ke baad phool deta hai aur masnoi chhote din de kar bhi phool laaye ja sakte hain.
Phool par asar: din ki lambai tay karti hai ke phool kab aayega. Baad mein pata chala ke asal ahem cheez raat (andhere) ki lambai hai; is liye short-day plants asal mein long-night plants hain. Short-day plant ki lambi raat mein thori roshni dal di jaye to phool nahi aata; long-day plant ki lambi raat tor di jaye to chhote dinon mein bhi phool aa jata hai.
Farq (table dekhein):
Phytochrome ka kirdar:
- Phytochrome roshni pehchanne wala protein hai jis ki do shaklein hain: P660 (ghair-faal) red light (660 nm) le kar P730 (faal) banta hai; P730 far-red light (730 nm) le kar wapas P660 banta hai.
- Din mein P660 → P730; andhere mein P730 → P660. P730 → P660 ki raftar ghari (clock) ki tarah andhere ka waqt naapti hai.
- Red light (P730) short-day plants mein phool rokta aur long-day plants mein phool laata hai. Is liye short-day plant tab phool deta hai jab raat itni lambi ho ke P730 kam ho jaye; long-day plant ko chhoti raat chahiye taake P730 bacha rahe.
- Ab mana jata hai ke sirf P660/P730 hi control nahi karte; roshni ka hona ya na hona aur din/raat ki lambai bhi ahem hain.
- Clock ke asar se patte florigen hormone banate hain jo phloem ke raste phool ki kaliyon tak ja kar phool shuru karta hai.

rows: Raat critical length se lambi ho to phool
Raat critical length se chhoti ho to phool
Phool din ki lambai se azad
Critical raat: cocklebur 8.5 h, tobacco 10-11 h
Critical raat: henbane 13 h
Koi critical length nahi
P730 (red light) phool rokta hai; raat mein roshni se phool nahi aata
P730 (red light) phool laata hai; raat tootne se chhote dinon mein bhi phool
Din ki lambai ka asar nahi

blocks.prompt:
1. Can you explain the hypothesis regarding the opening and closing of stomata?
Kya aap stomata ke khulne aur band hone ki hypothesis samjha sakte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Guard cells ka turgor badalne ki do hypotheses:
1. Starch-sugar hypothesis (Von Mohl, 1856): din mein guard cells photosynthesis se sugar banate hain; water potential girta, pani andar, cells turgid, stoma khula. Raat ko sugar starch ban jati ya respiration mein lagti hai, pani bahar, cells flaccid, stoma band. Yeh tez tabdeeli ki wazahat nahi karti.
2. K⁺ influx hypothesis: roshni (khaas kar blue light) mein K⁺ active tor par guard cells mein jate hain, osmotic potential girta, pani andar, stoma khulta hai. Raat ko K⁺ bahar nikalte, pani bhi nikalta aur stoma band. Pani ki kami mein abscisic acid K⁺ pump rok kar stomata band karta hai.
K⁺ wali hypothesis tez harkat ko behtar samjhati hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. What mechanisms enable carnivorous plants to supplement their nutrient uptake despite being autotrophs?
Carnivorous (keere khane wale) plants autotroph hone ke bawajood kin tareeqon se apni ghiza mein izafa karte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Insectivorous plants asal autotrophs hain (photosynthesis karte hain), magar aisi mitti mein ugte hain jahan nitrogen kam ho (beyond the chapter: mitti ki kami chapter mein nahi likhi); yeh keere aur chhote janwar pakar kar hazam karte aur un se organic, khaas kar nitrogen wale, compounds lete hain jis se in ki nashunuma tez hoti hai.
Tareeqe:
1. Pitcher plant: patta ghare (pitcher) mein badla hota hai jis mein kuch pani hota hai, upar dhakkan (hood); sakht baal girne wale keere ko bahar nahi nikalne dete.
2. Venus flytrap: patte ke sire par do qabze (hinge) wale lobes ka jaal; andar trichomes (trigger hairs) chhoone par lobes foran band ho jate hain aur kinaron ke baal aapas mein phans kar shikar ko bhagne nahi dete.
3. Sundew: patton par tentacle jaise baal, har gland par chamakdar chipchipa "dew" ka qatra; boo se aaye keere tentacles mein phans jate hain.
Teenon mein shikar patte ke glands ke enzymes se hazam hota aur hasil cheezein (nitrogen wale compounds) jazb hoti hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. How can you say that parenchyma and schlerenchyma provide support to plants?
Aap kaise keh sakte hain ke parenchyma aur sclerenchyma plants ko sahara dete hain?
blocks.explanation:
Parenchyma: is ke cells (epidermis, cortex, pith) pani jazb karte hain. Tonoplast ions ko vacuole mein pump karta hai, pani osmosis se andar aa kar turgor pressure banata hai. Phoole (turgid) cells aapas mein dab kar naram (herbaceous) hisson ko seedha aur sakht rakhte hain. Saboot: pani ki kami mein turgor khatam aur plant murjha (wilt) jata hai.
Sclerenchyma: is ke cells ki moti secondary walls mein lignin bhara hota hai jo mazbooti aur sakhti deta hai; zyada tar cells mukammal ho kar mur jate (dead) aur sirf sahara dete hain. Fibres bundles ya bundle caps banate, sclereids beej ke chhilke aur akhrot ke khol sakht karte hain, xylem vessels/fibres mechanical sahara dete hain. Saboot: lakri wale hisse pani ke baghair bhi sakht rehte hain.
Yani parenchyma pani ke dabao (turgor) se aur sclerenchyma lignin wali deewaron se sahara deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "schlerenchyma" chhapa hai (spelling ki ghalti); sahi lafz "sclerenchyma" hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. How do the annual rings depict climatic variability?
Annual rings mausam (climate) ki tabdeeli ko kaise zahir karti hain?
blocks.explanation:
Annual rings vascular cambium ki mausami sargarmi se banti hain. Bahar (spring) mein achhe halaat mein cambium zyada xylem chaure vessels ke saath banata hai: halki (light) spring wood. Khizan (autumn) mein sargarmi kam, kam aur tang gaarhe xylem elements: gehri (dark) autumn wood. Ek spring wood + ek autumn wood = ek annual ring.
Mausam ka record: har ring ki chaurai aur gaarhapan us saal ke halaat batate hain. Chauri ring achha saal (kafi pani, munasib temperature), patli ring bura saal (khushk saali, thand). Rings ki tarteeb parh kar (dendrochronology) darakht ki umar aur purane mausam aur waqiaat maloom kiye jate hain, yaani lambe arse ki climatic variability.

blocks.prompt:
5. How does Pressure Flow Theory explain the movement of sugars through a plant?
Pressure Flow Theory plant mein sugars ki harkat kaise samjhati hai?
blocks.explanation:
Pressure-flow (mass-flow) theory Ernst Munch (1930) ne di. Sugars phloem mein source (jahan banti hain, maslan patta) se sink (jahan istemal ya zakheera hoti hain, maslan phal, jar) ki taraf osmotic pressure ke farq se jati hain:
1. Mesophyll mein bani glucose ka kuch hissa respiration mein lagta, baqi sucrose ban jata hai.
2. Sucrose active transport se companion cells mein aur plasmodesmata se sieve tubes mein jata hai; sieve tubes mein sucrose barh jata hai.
3. Saath ke xylem se pani osmosis se sieve tubes mein aata hai; source end par hydrostatic pressure (dabao) zyada ho jata hai (kitab isay zyada water potential kehti hai).
4. Sink par sucrose active tor par utara (unload) jata hai aur pani bhi nikal jata hai; sink end par dabao kam.
5. Dabao ka farq pani ka bulk flow source se sink ki taraf chalata hai aur ghuli hui sucrose saath behti hai.
Is se tez raftar (taqreeban 1 m fi ghanta) samajh aati hai jo diffusion (aath saal mein 1 m) se mumkin nahi.

blocks.prompt:
6. What strategies would you adopt to induce flowering in a plant?
Plant mein phool laane ke liye aap kaun si tadabeer (strategies) apnayenge?
blocks.explanation:
1. Photoperiod control: short-day plant ko lambi aur bina tooti raatein (critical length se lambi) dein; long-day plant ko chhoti raatein dein ya lambi raat mein thori roshni dal kar tor dein.
2. Vernalisation: biennials/perennials (ya un ke beejon) ko taqreeban 4°C par chaar din se teen mahine tak thand dein; shoot apex ya embryo stimulus leta aur vernalin phool lata hai.
3. Plant growth regulators: gibberellins (red light ki jagah le sakte hain) long-day plants mein phool laate hain; abscisic acid short-day plants mein; ethylene pineapple mein phool laata hai.
4. Jahan din ki lambai control na ho sake wahan day-neutral plants lagayein.
5. Munasib ghiza dein: phosphorus phool aane mein madad deta hai, us ki kami phool der se laati hai.
